stories.title: Volunteer coastguard rescue officers wanted for mud, cliff and water rescues
stories.summary: HM Coastguard is looking for volunteer rescue officers, in an appeal shared by Flint Coastguard Rescue Team. Coastguard rescue officers are called out to mud, cliff and water rescues, and to searches for missing people. stories.summary: North Wales Police has launched a Mountain Rescue Support Team, which the force says is the first police team of its kind in England and Wales. stories.title: North Wales Police warn of callers posing as Metropolitan Police officers
stories.summary: North Wales Police have warned of fraudsters posing as Metropolitan Police officers and claiming to be investigating people’s cryptocurrency accounts. stories.title: Nearly 4,700 people in Flintshire and Wrexham turned to Citizens Advice last year
stories.summary: Citizens Advice Flintshire and Citizens Advice Wrexham supported 4,657 people with more than 23,000 separate issues over the course of a year, the two charities have said. The problems people brought to them covered debt, benefits, employment and housing. The figures were set out during a visit to the charity’s Deeside office by Marc Jones

stories.title: Rare bush dog pups emerge at Chester Zoo after 65-day pregnancy
stories.summary: Five bush dog pups have come out of their den at Chester Zoo for the first time, and the zoo says they are the only ones born in the UK this year.
